chapter_seo_title: The Lizard's Tail – A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 362
chapter_meta_description: Han Li goes undercover at a White Pool Mountain gathering. He gets a full intel dump on the Yue-Demonic War and learns Yellow Maple Valley sacrificed two whole waves of disciples as bait. No action, all calculation.
og_title: Ch. 362: A Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – The Lizard Discovers His Own Tail Has Been Cut
og_description: Han Li sits down for tea and walks away with the most brutal intelligence report of his life: his sect sold its weakest disciples to save the strongest.
twitter_title: RMJI Chapter 362: Han Li Gets the Bad News on Ice
twitter_description: No fight, no treasure, just a stone-table Q&A that drops one devastating truth: Yellow Maple Valley cut off its own tail to survive.

lore_anchors.definition: A classical Chinese metaphor for strategic self-harm: sacrificing a lower-value part of the whole to preserve the rest. In xianxia, it refers to a sect abandoning or sacrificing lesser disciples to ensure the elite core survives the rout.

A classic Chinese strategic ploy: create a convincing decoy to misdirect the enemy while the real asset slips away unnoticed. In Yellow Maple Valley’s case, the “decoy” was a wave of living disciples, deliberately leaked to Devilish Dao pursuers.
The original seven orthodox sects of the Yue Kingdom cultivation world, now scattered after the losing war against the Six Devilish Dao Sects.
The six major demonic-path sects invading Yue. Currently overstretched, they are dealing with guerrilla harassment from Core Formation holdouts.
